subject.title: feat: add Pioneer.ai as an inference provider with live model discovery

question: Should OpenClaw accept Pioneer as an official provider with owned auth/default/catalog docs and gateway startup warm behavior, or should this remain an external ClawHub/npm plugin until maintainers sponsor it?
rationale: This is a new official provider and runtime behavior surface from an external contributor, not a narrow bug fix that automation can accept on its own.

options.title: Accept after repairs and security review
options.body: Keep the provider PR open and merge only after the credential-resolution bug is fixed plus dependency/secops and gateway behavior approval are visible.

options.title: Keep Pioneer external
options.body: Close or redirect the work to a separately maintained ClawHub/npm plugin without official OpenClaw provider ownership.

options.title: Narrow the PR
options.body: Ask the author to remove gateway/global behavior and keep only the provider plugin/docs surface for separate maintainer approval.

recommendation.title: Accept after repairs and security review
recommendation.body: Keep the provider PR open and merge only after the credential-resolution bug is fixed plus dependency/secops and gateway behavior approval are visible.

likelyOwner.reason: Provider catalog ownership, endpoint manifest policy, credential handling, and official-provider acceptance all intersect with recent steipete history on these surfaces.
